problem_statement: The conversion routines between Zephyr k_timeout_t timeouts and POSIX struct timespec durations produce incorrect or unsafe results for several durations. Converting a duration to ticks and back must round up to the next tick boundary for any non-zero finite duration that fits within the maximum representable tick count, round down to the maximum representable tick count for durations above that boundary (keeping finite durations finite rather than collapsing them to K_FOREVER), map the maximum representable timespec to K_FOREVER, and treat non-positive or negative durations as K_NO_WAIT. The conversion that produces the remainder must report the difference between the requested and converted durations. Converting a negative (absolute) timeout must be rejected rather than silently accepted, and normalizing/adding/negating/overflowing timespecs must be correct for any supported width of the time field. The expected durations for a fixed tick rate (e.g. the maximum representable timespec and its remainder) must match the documented semantics.
